what: An unofficial local MCP server for monday.com. It runs on the user's machine, talks to the monday.com GraphQL API, and keeps the token local. Its README also maps two browser-based access modes.
audience: Developers and AI agent users who connect MCP clients such as Claude or Cursor to monday.com.
landing_job: None. The repo has no landing page. The README at README.md:1 is the only front door, and it explains install and the three access modes.

identity.look: No visual identity. The repo holds no CSS, HTML, fonts, logo or design tokens. Its only colour values are test fixture data at test/fake-monday.ts:23-24, which are not brand colours.

notes: CLI and API server with no visual surface. Search covered README, AGENTS.md (absent), CONTRIBUTING.md and all source. No claude.ai artifact or design URL found. The package homepage is a GitHub repo, not a live site, so public_url is empty. Evidence digest found 29 scanned files and no design files.
